deviations_from_v11_md: K = 1 for every V11 arm: no strategy codes, no prior, no visit-2 code injection (2,040 parameters fewer than V10.3 deployed).

L_v2 is computed by recomputing visit 2 for all rows from stopped committed inputs (u1, anchor, E->C sources) and taking the S sampled rows; v11.md §5.2 attends to a stopped committed KV instead, so here the shared core weights also receive L_v2 gradient through earlier rows keys/values.
No random-prefix training: the objective test uses the inherited V10.3-tiny stream so the X8/C0 comparison is clean; alignment is tested by offset scoring in the evaluator for every arm.
trainer_notes: Same trainer for all six arms; with --foreach off it reproduces v10_3_tiny.train bitwise for C0 and X8 over 12 steps (tests_trainer). Production runs use --foreach (AdamW multi-tensor), which differs from the inherited trainer only at rounding level.
Runs share the GPU three at a time; wall clock depends on co-scheduled arms. Equal-wall-time comparisons use solo smoke step times, not this run's elapsed time.
